rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a successful accomplishment, and in games it means an unlocked achievement.

example.english: Completing this project successfully is truly an achievement for our team.
example.traditional: 今次個計劃順利完成，真係我哋團隊嘅成就。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 go3 gai3 waak6 seon6 lei6 jyun4 sing4 zan1 hai6 ngo5 dei6 tyun4 deoi6 ge3 sing4 zau6

rows.note: Use this for a notable or heroic feat achieved through boldness or courage.

example.english: Swimming across the English Channel alone was truly an achievement.
example.traditional: 佢單人游過英倫海峽，真係一項壯舉。
example.jyutping: keoi5 daan1 jan4 jau4 gwo3 jing1 leon4 hoi2 hap6 zan1 hai6 jat1 hong6 zong3 geoi2
